detected_issues.description: The cup is visibly suspended above the wooden tabletop. Metadata confirms the cup bottom is at Z=1.145 while the tabletop top is at Z=0.800.
All rendered views are very dark and the scene lacks balanced studio illumination. Metadata shows the area light energy is only 18.0 and color management exposure is -1.2.
The cup appears as a plain gray/default material rather than a ceramic surface. Metadata lists the material as default_gray_cup_material.
The main subject is not well centered in the camera view, with the cup and table shifted toward the lower-left area and large unused dark space dominating the frame.

repair_suggestions.suggested_action: Move ceramic_cup and ceramic_cup_handle downward until the cup bottom bounding box aligns with the wooden_table top surface.
repair_suggestions.expected_effect: The cup will physically rest on the table instead of floating.

repair_suggestions.suggested_action: Increase area_key_light energy, keep it as an area light, and reset color management exposure closer to 0.
repair_suggestions.expected_effect: The cup and table will become clearly visible under balanced studio lighting.

repair_suggestions.suggested_action: Assign a white ceramic material with moderate roughness and subtle specular reflection to ceramic_cup and ceramic_cup_handle.
repair_suggestions.expected_effect: The cup will read visually as ceramic instead of default gray.

repair_suggestions.suggested_action: Move and rotate the Camera to frame both the cup and table near the center of the image.
repair_suggestions.expected_effect: The cup will be clearly visible in the camera view and the composition will match the target description.

summary: The scene contains the intended major defects: the cup is floating, lighting is severely underexposed, the cup material is default gray rather than ceramic, and the camera composition is poorly framed.
